purpose: head-end thermal BC for the pintle-servo mount check (lead request 2026-10-12)
supersedes: v2.2 run 1 (headend_thermal_v2_run1_superseded.json): no re-radiation, one-way joint -> unphysical case node 670-1890 K

geometry.source: Mechanical CAD v3.2 parts_engine.py (read only; Mechanical confirms)

head_mass_kg.note: 0.2 low-mass bound; 0.44 = CAD v3.2 TC-02 estimate from dimensions (DERIVED)

constructions.bare: no face disc (disc lost / not fitted)
constructions.disc2mm: CAD v3.2 TC-10 2 mm phenolic disc

n2o_side.geometry: CAD v3.2 manifold: 10 mm bore around the 6 mm needle body (D_h 4 mm, A 50.3 mm2), wetted bore 10 x 52 mm
n2o_side.formula: h_c = 0.023 Re^0.8 Pr^0.4 k / D_h, Re = (mdot/A) D_h / mu
n2o_side.coast: static liquid at the tank temperature, hA 1 W/K (ASSUMED 1000 W/m2K x 10 cm2)
n2o_side.soak: vapour only, hA 0.01 W/K (no evaporative credit)

coast_soak_gas_side.radiation: face <-> insulator (F 0.65), face <-> grain end (F 0.35), emissivity 0.8

pintle_needle.note: 17-4PH 4 mm stem over 0.10 m: 2.3e-3 W/K, i.e. < 1 W at 300 K difference: the needle is not a heat path to the servo; its tip takes the injector-face BC and the N2O-side h_c (it sits in the flow)

not_modelled: phenolic pyrolysis/char/ablation (no credit); axial conduction along the 6061 case from the hot aft end (post-landing item for the FEA: fin m 4.5 1/m, cosh mL 1.8, diffusion ~1000 s); gradients inside the head (diffusion ~60 s); head-to-servo path (bonnet, bracket TC-12)
